name: codex-threadctl
description: Codex skill for finding, inspecting, and controlling app-server-backed threads.

interface.shortDescription: Find, inspect, and control app-server-backed Codex threads.
interface.longDescription: Codex Threadctl provides guidance for discovering and searching persisted threads, inspecting activity, item ranges, context, messages, and terminal processes, starting or steering input, resuming stored threads, interrupting exact turns, and terminating exact terminal processes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-threadctl to find, inspect, or immediately control a Codex thread.
